phase_name: Regression cases for the new mechanisms

objectives.description: Re-read house style (pass/fail/info/skip, G1-G3 stub-argv-log pattern, U4 isolated PATH)
Case P1: PATH-ordering (stub lake at toolchain-bin path, non-executable decoy earlier on PATH)
Case P2: elan-wrapper case (lake.orig unwrap into private dir)
Case P3: shim-wiring case (COMPARATOR_LANDRUN points at shim)
Case P4: shim-grants case (direct shim invocation, TMPDIR + --rox in logged argv)
Case P5: pre-flight-probe case (stub git failure -> comparator_unavailable naming package)
Anti-vacuous mutation check for P1/P2 (invert lake.orig executable check)
Extend header comment block with new concern group (4), extend E1/E2 skip text
No manifest.json change needed (test file already listed)

approaches_tried.description: Assert P1/P2 via filesystem inspection (readlink -f, -L symlink check) on paths captured while the tool's WORKDIR still existed
approaches_tried.reason: run_tool() does not pass --keep-workdir by default, so the tool's own EXIT trap removes WORKDIR (and LAKE_DIR) before the test's post-hoc filesystem checks ran; fixed by passing --keep-workdir explicitly for this one case

approaches_tried.description: Reuse existing write_lake_stub(path) directly on a toolchain-bin DIRECTORY for the elan-wrapper cases
approaches_tried.reason: write_lake_stub's signature writes to a single FILE path, not a directory; added a new write_wrapped_lake_stub(dir) helper that writes lake.orig (via write_lake_stub) plus a lake wrapper script execing it

deviations.description: Confirm at implementation time by counting the new pass/fail case labels actually added; if a mechanism turns out to be unobservable through a stub ... record it as an explicit skip
deviations.reason: All six new cases (P1-P5 plus the Fix-1 mutation check) are fully observable via stubs on this host -- none required a SKIP. Six new pass/fail case labels were added (P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, plus one dedicated mutation check), matching the plan's own count of 'six new cases plus one mutation check'.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — none of the six new cases needed a SKIP; all fully exercised via stubs, confirmed by the suite's own 28-passed/0-failed/1-skipped summary)*
